### SecOps RAG — seed IR runbooks
Upserts curated incident-response runbooks into Pinecone (index `outreach-kb`, namespace `secops`) so the Alert Triage agent's `search_runbooks` tool returns real procedures + severity guidance.

Run once (and re-run after editing the runbooks). `clearNamespace` wipes + reseeds each run.

**Wire-up:** OpenAI + Pinecone credentials (same ones the triage workflow uses). Then run, and re-test the triage — it'll cite these runbooks.

nodes.notes: Select Pinecone credential. Index outreach-kb, namespace secops.
